import sys
sys.path.append('storage/shared/consensus_v1_6')
from harness import run_consensus_phantom
from aggregate_v1_6 import main as aggregate_main

# Pilot with extras and fields
run_consensus_phantom(
    lineage="veritas",
    agent="Veritas III",
    seed=0,
    depth=5,
    agents=3,
    innovation={"myth_strength": "consensus * innov", "heuristic": "equilibria_vote", "equilibria_index": "consensus * myth_strength"}
)

# Call aggregator
aggregate_main()
print("Aggregation Complete")
